tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Check if a .i sovereign domain is available for registration across all 4 supported chains (Arbitrum One, Optimism, Ethereum, Robinhood).

tools.name: resolve_domain_identity
tools.description: Resolve a .i web3 domain name or 0x Ethereum wallet address to its sovereign identity, owner, metadata, social links, and current chain location.

tools.name: get_supported_chains
tools.description: Retrieve technical network specifications, Chainlink CCIP selectors, router contracts, and registry addresses for all 4 supported chains.

tools.name: estimate_registration
tools.description: Calculate registration fee, escrow payment requirements, and cross-chain CCIP bridging costs on any of the 4 supported networks.

tools.name: set_primary_domain
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned transaction payload to set or update the primary reverse resolution domain identity for a given wallet address on Arbitrum One. Requires user wallet signature.

tools.name: update_domain_profile
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned transaction payload to update decentralized identity profile metadata, social links, website URL, and IPFS avatar CID on-chain. Requires owner wallet signature.

tools.name: marketplace_browse_listings
tools.description: Browse active .i domains listed on the decentralized secondary marketplace across Arbitrum One and satellite networks.

tools.name: marketplace_get_domain_details
tools.description: Inspect full marketplace status for any .i domain: active listing, price history, highest offer, and bids.

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned on-chain transaction payload to permanently register a .i sovereign domain (0.001 ETH). Returns contract calldata, destination address, and value for user wallet signature.

tools.name: marketplace_list_domain
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned transaction payload to list an owned .i domain for sale on the secondary marketplace. Requires owner wallet signature.

tools.name: marketplace_buy_domain
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned payable transaction payload with ETH value to purchase an actively listed .i domain from the marketplace contract. Requires buyer wallet signature.

tools.name: marketplace_make_offer
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned transaction payload to submit an offer in ETH to purchase any registered .i domain. Requires buyer wallet signature.

tools.name: marketplace_accept_offer
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned atomic swap transaction payload accepting a buyer offer on your .i domain. Requires seller wallet signature.

tools.name: marketplace_cancel_listing
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned transaction payload to cancel an active marketplace listing. Requires seller wallet signature.

tools.name: marketplace_cancel_offer
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned transaction payload to cancel an active marketplace offer. Requires buyer wallet signature.

tools.name: transfer_domain
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned ERC-721 transferFrom transaction payload to transfer sovereign ownership of a .i domain to another 0x EVM wallet address. Requires owner wallet signature.

tools.name: bridge_domain
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned CCIP cross-chain bridge transaction payload to teleport a .i domain to another supported EVM chain. Requires owner wallet signature.

tools.name: claim_escrow_refund
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned transaction payload to claim an eligible escrow refund from the Escrow contract. Requires claimant wallet signature.

tools.name: get_protocol_stats
tools.description: Fetch live protocol metrics including total registered domains, active secondary marketplace listings, and cross-chain CCIP bridge health.
